summary: Add pkg/automation/catalog (registry of node types, trigger sources and connectors with a per-tenant catalog filtered by connections and author rights) and pkg/automation/connectors (AES-256-GCM connection store in the new automation schema with key rotation, platform credentials, usage, OAuth2 and a host.SecretResolver bridge), configured by AUTOMATION_CONNECTIONS_KEYS. graph.EventSpec and EventView gain an optional Description.
